notes: Portuguese has now had the same full review Croatian had, and French is hidden for now so the two live courses get all the attention. Every Portuguese lesson title is in English, so you can tell what a lesson is before you can read Portuguese. The end-of-lesson recall is answerable in all 240 lessons: rows that were really tables (whole verb tables in one line, rules written with arrows and equals signs) are now single phrases you can actually type, with the rule moved to the note underneath. Six B1 lessons that had nothing short enough to recall got proper practice phrases. On the flashcard side, no two cards share a sentence any more, and two blocks of themed words no longer arrive weeks before the lesson that teaches them.
